text:
sam_sdr: Heads up - AcmeTech's security team just pinged me: they need sample SIEM evidence for the POC. They asked: 1) retention proof for 12 months, 2) admin activity log samples, 3) explanation of export mechanisms to SIEM, and 4) who has access to audit logs. Can we assemble a short bundle by EOD?

olivia_sec: I can handle the retention attestation + controls paragraph. Quick check: POC is hosted API only, correct?

sam_sdr: Yes hosted only for now.

dan_sre: I'll generate sanitized JSONL examples and a curl to pull audit events. We use immutable object storage with Object Lock + KMS encryption; ingestion streams to Kafka and to our audit S3.

dan_sre: Example curl (redacted token):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  'https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/admin/audit?org_id=acmetech&start=2025-09-01T00:00:00Z&end=2025-09-30T23:59:59Z' \
  -o acmetech-audit.json
```

dan_sre: sample logs (JSONL):
```json
{"timestamp":"2025-09-03T11:05:22Z","event":"org.user.promote","actor":"user:jo@acmetech.com","target":"org:acmetech","request_id":"req_ABC123","ip":"198.51.100.22"}
{"timestamp":"2025-09-10T02:14:09Z","event":"api.key.rotate","actor":"system:service-account","target":"org:acmetech","request_id":"req_DEF456","notes":"automated key rotation"}
{"timestamp":"2025-09-21T18:44:55Z","event":"model.access","actor":"user:svc-runner@acmetech.com","target":"model:gptx-13b","request_id":"req_GHI789","latency_ms":84}
```

tara_pre-sales: Can you add the IAM roles that can read audit data? Customers ask for that a lot.

dan_sre: IAM roles: audit_viewer (read-only), audit_writer (ingest-only), audit_manager (configure retention/exports). Offboarding: IdP deprovision -> automation revokes group memberships, we log the change in the audit manifest. Monthly signed manifests are available.

olivia_sec: I'll draft a short one-paragraph explanation for each control: encryption at rest (KMS), immutability (S3 Object Lock), tamper evidence (checksums + signed manifests), access control (RBAC + IdP), and retention enforcement (lifecycle + legal hold).

sam_sdr: Also include simple SIEM integration steps (syslog webhook or HTTPS). dan, can you paste a sample rsyslog config?

dan_sre: Sure - minimal rsyslog snippet:
```conf
# /etc/rsyslog.d/50-redwood-forward.conf
module(load=\"omfwd\")
*.* action(type=\"omfwd\" Target=\"siem.acmetech.internal\" Port=\"514\" Protocol=\"tcp\")
```

auditbot: Monthly audit manifest uploaded: s3://prod-redwood-audit/manifests/2025-09.sig

tara_pre-sales: I'll package the attestation + samples + integration notes and send to AcmeTech by 17:30 PT. We can offer a time-limited live export if they want to ingest and validate.

sam_sdr: Awesome, thanks all. I'll update the CRM notes and tag the AE. :rocket:
